info.title: Flappy mini-app backend
info.description:
Backend of the Flappy mini-app. Pick an API in the selector at the top right:
**Player API** for the mini-app frontend, **Core app API** for the core app and operators.

### Errors
Every error is `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`:

| code | HTTP | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | A field or parameter is missing or invalid; see `errors` or `detail`. |
| `MALFORMED_REQUEST` | 400 | The request could not be read (bad JSON, wrong type in the path, unsupported method). |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | 400 | The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | No valid access token. Refresh it, or log in again. |
| `INVALID_LAUNCH_TOKEN` | 401 | The launch token is invalid, expired or already used. Get a new one from the core app. |
| `INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN` | 401 | The refresh token is unknown, expired, already used or revoked. Log in again with a new launch token. |
| `INVALID_SIGNATURE` | 401 | HMAC headers are missing or the signature does not match. |
| `SIGNATURE_EXPIRED` | 401 | `X-Timestamp` is more than 5 minutes away from the server clock. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | The caller is not allowed to do this. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No such resource. |
| `SESSION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No such game session for this player. |
| `ORDER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No such order (for this player). |
| `BIRD_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No such bird. See `GET /api/v1/birds` for the codes. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_LIVES` | 409 | The player has no lives left. |
| `SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE` | 409 | The game is already finished or expired, or older than 15 minutes. |
| `SESSION_ALREADY_FINISHED` | 409 | The game was already finished with a different score. |
| `TOURNAMENT_NOT_ACTIVE` | 409 | No tournament is running, so games cannot be started and lives cannot be bought. See `GET /api/v1/tournament`. |
| `NICKNAME_REQUIRED` | 409 | The player has not chosen a nickname yet. Set one with `PUT /api/v1/me/nickname`, then start the game. |
| `NICKNAME_TAKEN` | 409 | Another player already uses this nickname (upper and lower case count as the same). Choose another. |
| `NICKNAME_ALREADY_SET` | 409 | The player already has a different nickname; it cannot be changed. |
| `BIRD_LOCKED` | 409 | The bird is not unlocked yet: the player's total score in this tournament is below its `unlockScore`. |
| `ORDER_STATE_CONFLICT` | 409 | The debit report contradicts the order (amount, user, or status). Nothing was changed; needs manual review. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Too many requests. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected server error. Safe to retry with the same `Idempotency-Key`. |
| `CORE_APP_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | The core app could not be reached. Try again shortly. |
| `LEADERBOARD_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | The leaderboard store is temporarily unavailable. |
| `REFRESH_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | Tokens cannot be refreshed right now. Log in again with a new launch token. |

### Idempotency-Key
Requests that spend or commit something need an `Idempotency-Key` header with a UUID:
a new one per user action, reused only to retry that same action. A repeated key
returns the original result (HTTP 200 instead of 201) and has no further effect.

put.summary: Choose the nickname shown on the leaderboard
put.description: Required before the first game. 3 to 16 characters: Mongolian or Latin letters (not both in one name), digits and `_`, with at least one letter. Unique among all players, ignoring upper and lower case. Chosen once: repeating the same name is fine, a different one is refused.

post.summary: Create an order for a number of lives
post.description: Creates a PENDING order for `quantity` lives, priced from the database (see `GET /lives/price`). Only possible while a tournament is running; unused lives are removed when it ends. Then open the core app payment screen over the JS bridge with ONLY the `orderId`, and poll the order until it is no longer PENDING.

post.summary: Submit the result of a game
post.description: `durationMs` is the wall-clock time from receiving the start response to game over, with no pauses. The answer is HTTP 200 with `status` FINISHED (the score is added to the player's tournament total) or REJECTED (more points than the speed schedule allows in the time played, or a duration that disagrees with the server's; see `rejectReason`). Sending the same score again returns the stored result. `newlyUnlocked` lists the birds this game unlocked.

post.summary: Start a game (uses a free play, or 1 life when none is left)
post.description: Every player has a number of free plays per Ulaanbaatar day; they are used first and are not carried over. After that each game costs one earned life. `paidWith` says which was used. Only possible while a tournament is running and after the player has chosen a nickname. The game must be finished within 15 minutes. `config.speed` says how the game speeds up (see the schema); the client must follow it, because scores are checked against the same schedule.

post.summary: Log in: trade a launch token for our tokens
post.description: The launch token comes from the core app over the JS bridge and works once. Creates the player on first login. If `refreshAvailable` is false, no refresh token is returned: when the access token expires, get a new launch token from the bridge and call this again. Limited per client IP.

get.summary: The running tournament and the next planned one
get.description: `current` is null between tournaments: no game can be started and no lives can be bought then. `next` is null if nothing is planned. `endsAt` is exclusive. Lives that are not used by `endsAt` are removed.

get.summary: Nickname, free plays, lives, best score and tournament rank of the logged-in player
get.description: `nickname` is null until the player has chosen one; ask for it before the first game. `tournamentRank` and `totalScore` are null until the player finishes a game in the tournament, or while the leaderboard store is unavailable.

get.description: Lives are bought by quantity: an order for N lives costs N × `pointsPerLife` points. `maxLivesPerOrder` is a technical ceiling for one order; a player may place any number of orders.

get.summary: Top players of the tournament and the caller's own position
get.description: Shows the running tournament; between tournaments, the final standings of the last one (`tournament.running` is false). `entries` are the top `limit` players (1 to 100, default 10). `me` is the caller's own rank and total whatever the `limit`, or null if they have not finished a game in this tournament: show it as an extra row when the caller is not in `entries`. Refresh about once a minute.

get.summary: All birds, which ones the player has unlocked, and which one is selected
get.description: A bird is unlocked once the player's total score in the tournament reaches its `unlockScore`. A new tournament starts from 0, so birds lock again; the player then plays with the default bird (`unlockScore` 0) until they unlock their pick again. Draw each bird by its `code`.
